block_definition: Zero-based blocks0..7;first7 have12frames,last has8. History statistics use the previous4generated frames except initial observed history,error0 by definition. Per-system RMSE pools draws,selected frames and selected bonds before equal-system aggregation.
feedback_observation: A ligand output-minus-history RMSE is positive under marginal intervals in6of7 later blocks;block6 remains unresolved. Protein/all differences are positive in5of7 later blocks;blocks5/6 unresolved. These are descriptive comparisons between different time/frame windows,not an additive or causal error decomposition.

source_inspection.training: molvid/training/coordinate_state.py dynamic branch slices the real observed prefix unchanged;coordinate noise affects future training state,not dynamic history. Static singleton corruption uses a distinct task with temporal bypass.
source_inspection.rollout: molvid/evaluation/bridge_rollout.py uses the initial realH4,then replaces x,bpos and times with generated history. CoordinateStateDenoiser.prepare_condition reencodes that history and uses its last frame as reference. No clean future is injected.
source_inspection.confirmed: Clean-history training versus generated-history recursion is an actual distribution difference,not yet a proven cause of the measured drift.

decision: Do not explain failure solely by history exposure or prioritize history augmentation as a sufficient fix. The first full source-sampled block is already geometrically poor despite real history,and the deficit affects protein as well as ligand. Evaluate source-generated local geometry alongside temporal/history coupling;use completed static-complex and paired rollout evidence to choose the next controlled intervention. Do not return to clean-latent decoder-only claims.

rejected_structural_hypothesis.hypothesis: At high noise,vanishing radial basis features structurally force all covalent messages to zero despite retaining graph edges
rejected_structural_hypothesis.finding: Not supported by actual code.CoordinateStateDenoiser._graph concatenates actual-distance RBF with independent binary bond_embedding;bonded envelope distance is0.NeighborEmbedding projects the full concatenation before its exempt envelope,and attention dk/dv also project the concatenation.ExpNormalSmearing has its own actual-distance cutoff,so its radial channel can be0,but the bond-identity channel is not multiplied by that radial cutoff.
rejected_structural_hypothesis.consequence: Do not add a redundant covalent-message branch merely to repair this nonexistent forced-zero pathway.Adequate learned usage,high-noise distance information and chemical expressivity remain separate unproven questions.
rejected_structural_hypothesis.evidence_type: Source inspection only;no new CUDA or learned-weight ablation was executed
